g.text: CL65.2 the picture builder: one builder, mid-build
a drawn group, its width and height
a function of the final width
shared first, the kind's own last
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: A builder holds what it was told until Build:
nothing is written before the width is known.
